title: Tokens
wikitext:
'''Tokens''' are a [[Currency]] used when fighting [[Kuudra]], they can be used in [[Kuudra#Kuudra Perk Shop|Kuudra Perk Shop]] to purchase various perks that last for this one fight.
Tokens are obtained by killing mobs during Kuudra or hitting Kuudra's Tentacles with cannons. They are awarded to all players equally.
